criteria.selection: Choose one finite allowance from development only; keep return-home default if quality, tail or CPU tradeoffs are weak. No oracle end-of-stream controller.
criteria.quality: same SIPP/no-joint, identical serialized scenario, fixed return-home A* offline reference
criteria.timing: raw process CPU and wall only; one observation per run; offline reference/validation/scoring excluded
criteria.holdout: separate 30..39 seeds; do not retune on their outcomes
